decision: 用户选择方案一，冲煮与结构认识同屏；二维剖视壶需要与三维模型装配后的比例一致，轮廓修长。

interaction.left: 二维剖视用于观察水路与出液；操作火力、关火收取。
interaction.right: 三维爆炸结构用于点选部件、了解作用和控制展开程度。
interaction.timing: 结构阅读与部件点选不暂停教学冲煮；不要求读完全部部件才能收取。
interaction.safety: 右侧是独立虚拟结构展示，不把拆开的壶置于燃烧炉具上；热壶勿拆。

screens.prompt:
Use case: compositing / ui-mockup.
Input 1 is the approved BREWING interface base. Input 2 is the approved EXPLODED STRUCTURE interface with the correct six-part moka model. Redesign and MERGE their functions into ONE feasible desktop HTML page. Preserve the existing refined Italian poster identity, warm clean ivory, burnt sienna, restrained navy/olive, espresso text, geometric café silhouette poster, softly lit ivory stone counter, and finely cast/brushed silver moka material with matte black handle and brass valve. Generate ONE full-width 16:9 interface screenshot, no browser frame, no contact sheet.
The user's goal: the coffee is brewing while they can casually explore the moka's components on the RIGHT, then go to DIY. Structure learning is part of this same screen, not a separate route, modal, mandatory tutorial or timed quiz. There is no pause just because a part is selected. Both sides follow the same brewing state. Show mid-brew '连续出液 · 64 g', '教学时间加速'. The primary action is '关火收取，去调配 →'. On completion the virtual demo will turn off and wait for collection; do not promise real-world autonomous shutoff. Do not add a knowledge completion counter, unlock gate or read-every-part requirement.
Keep a tiny back link '← 准备', small process labels exactly '做基底 · 调配 · 出品' with 做基底 selected, and an unobtrusive upper-right ticket '来单 01 / 早餐奶咖 / 热饮 · 约200 g'. Heading compact, no giant slogans, no full navbar, no six-stage footer. Only ONE fire-control group '微火 / 小火 / 关火', 小火 selected, related to the 2D brewing view.
Critically: the 3D exploded object is a VIRTUAL STRUCTURE DISPLAY, physically separate from the illustrated burner in the 2D operational drawing. NEVER draw a live flame or burner under an exploded model. Include a discreet label '虚拟结构展示 · 热壶勿拆'. Every component must share ONE straight assembly axis; the lower vessel has no independent skew. Exactly six groups from top to bottom: lid with attached knob, upper chamber with black handle and spout, perforated filter disk, black annular gasket, hollow funnel basket with DOWNWARD tube, lower chamber with safety valve. Visible separation and no intersections. No detached spare handles, loose extra screws, or mystery extra cylinders.
Material and lighting are achievable with edited Blender geometry / restrained Three.js PBR and simple shadows, not mirror chrome. Dynamic water and coffee are deliberately simple SVG-style clipped liquid shapes and a few route arrows. No real 3D fluid, hand pouring, thread screwing, exploded stove simulation, fullscreen rotating-camera spectacle, fake exact pressure/temperature, taste scores or overloaded dashboards. All text concise and accurate. Focused information density and generous negative space.
VARIANT A: clearly balanced SIDE-BY-SIDE workbench; two distinct useful regions without hard frames. Heading top-left '一边冲煮，一边认识。' at modest size.
LEFT 43%: one large clean 2D illustrated teaching cutaway of the assembled moka pot, approximately 44% page height, with coherent lower water vessel, downward funnel stem in water, powder basket, upward chimney and coffee collection pool. Three arrows stay in the actual fluid path. A simple illustrated compact burner and low blue flame sit below THIS 2D pot only. Caption '压力差推动水穿过粉层'. Under this visual a short phase strip '受热 / 连续出液 / 后段' and live reading '64 g'. Fire selector and primary collection button are directly below, compact and clearly clickable. This is the ONLY active brewing operator.
RIGHT 49%: one elegant exploded 3D moka occupying about 64% page height, NOT the original assembled stove pot in addition. Highlight 粉篮. Keep only three unobtrusive currently useful hotspot labels '滤网 / 粉篮 / 下壶' on the outside, other part hotspots small dots. Immediately beneath model ONE narrow unboxed part note '粉篮' / '装满、铺平，不压实。' and tiny line '点部件，看看它的作用'. No second large basket model or third diagram. A subtle lower slider '展开程度' controls model separation, not brewing. Clearly separate boiler simulation and explanatory structure visually. Right far edge cropped rust/navy poster artwork, ivory countertop bottom no more than 12%. No tall detail sidebar. Give the model breathing space at top and bottom. Keep the primary collection button visible at all times.

Edit the supplied approved desktop coffee-science interface concept. User edit request: "很好，第一个方案吧，有个问题就是现在你做的这种二维效果的摩卡壶都有点瘪，感觉不是模型的界面的那种比例啊，要修长一点". Make a precise localized refinement of ONLY the assembled 2D cutaway Moka pot on the LEFT. Preserve the approved two-column parallel workbench, all Chinese UI wording, fonts, paper colors, the right exploded 3D stage and labels, the order ticket, poster, stove, tabletop, controls, button, composition and breathing room.

The left pot is currently squat and too broad. Redraw its geometry as an elegant taller/slimmer classic octagonal Moka pot, matching the physical proportions of the RIGHT 3D pot when assembled. Do not stretch the whole page or stove. A precise target: the LEFT central pot body measured from the top of the lid knob down to the bottom edge, excluding handle and spout, should have height-to-maximum-body-width approximately 2.05 to 2.15 : 1, instead of the current squat silhouette. Retain its current overall height and screen position approximately; reduce the body width by about 18-23 percent, while carefully reshaping upper and lower chambers. Upper chamber is a little narrower at its lower collar; lower water chamber is tall with tapered octagonal shoulders, not a broad flat bucket. Use the same slender taper and chamber ratios as the right physical model. Keep a normal short lid knob, a natural spout, a slim correct black handle and attachment points; don't vertically distort knob or handle. Keep lid, upper collector, collar/filter/basket region, water boiler aligned perfectly on one central vertical axis.

Redraw the cross-section internals to fit the new silhouette: a slender central chimney going upward to the upper collection chamber, coffee bed at the joining region, basket funnel stem extending downward into the water chamber, visible water level and headspace, simple water-path arrows. Keep the cutaway a legible flat/vector-like education overlay with restrained metal shading, NOT a transparent fantasy glass object. Coffee liquid remains dark brown in upper chamber, water restrained pale blue below. Do not make the internal coffee basket tall or add extra shelves/segments. Preserve educational caption '压力差推动水穿过粉层。'. Keep the assembled left pot seated on the unchanged 2D simulated burner with blue flame and existing stove placement. Absolutely preserve the right exploded model as a separate unheated virtual structure, with no flame or burner beneath it.

Final output a finished polished 16:9 interface screenshot at the same aspect ratio as the input. This is an achievable HTML/SVG plus static/limited 3D web UI, with no hands, fluid simulation spectacle, extra panels or animation ghosting. Only the left cutaway silhouette and its fitted internals should visibly change.
review: 左侧二维壶轮廓已收窄并保持原有视觉高度，上下壶、粉篮与管道随轮廓重绘。
两栏布局、火力与收取控件、出液进度、右侧爆炸结构与订单均保留。
属于布局与比例概念图，尚未修改产品代码或验证动效。
implementation: 在实现时使用实际三维模型装配态与固定机位获取二维外轮廓和关键结构位置，避免二维另行随意绘制导致比例失配。
内部液位、路径箭头、火力状态采用SVG/CSS动画；三维仅负责稳定的爆炸展开与部件聚焦。
